meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: Claude 会用 grep、ast-grep 等工具,从九个维度审查代码库的技术债务;每项发现都标注文件位置、严重程度与预估工时,最后在仓库根目录生成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,附优先修复顺序和快速修复清单。
howto.when: 当用户要求做代码库健康检查、技术债务审计、架构审查,或提及“tech debt”“code health”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我的仓库做一次技术债务审计,产出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say.note: 触发九维度审计并写入报告文件。

say.text: 检查代码库健康度,标出 Critical 和 High 的问题
say.note: 按严重程度分级,并附 file:line 证据。

say.text: 列出半小时内能修完的快速修复项
say.note: 报告会单列 Quick Wins 清单。

howto.what_en: Claude audits a codebase across nine dimensions for technical debt, using grep/ast-grep and optionally CodeGraph, citing file:line:col per finding, and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort, and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, or mentions keywords like 'tech debt', 'code health'.

say_en.text: Run a tech debt audit on my repo and produce TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say_en.note: Kicks off the nine-dimension audit and writes the report.

say_en.text: Check codebase health and flag Critical and High issues with file references
say_en.note: Findings are graded by severity, citing file:line per issue.

say_en.text: List the quick wins - fixes that take under 30 minutes each
say_en.note: Report lists a Quick Wins Checklist of sub-30-minute fixes.
